claim:
Let \(X\) be the real Day--James plane
\[
\|(x,y)\|_X=
\begin{cases}
|x|+|y|,&xy\ge0,\\
\bigl(|x|^3+|y|^3\bigr)^{1/3},&xy\le0.
\end{cases}
\]
Then
\[
d_{\mathrm{BM}}(X,\ell_2^2)^2=1+2^{-4/3}.
\]
An optimal Euclidean pullback is
\[
H_*(x,y)^2=(x+y)^2+2^{-4/3}(x-y)^2.
\]
Equivalently,
\[
d_{\mathrm{BM}}(X,\ell_2^2)=\sqrt{1+2^{-4/3}}
=1.181884200331001\ldots .
\]
integrity: The proof reduces arbitrary Euclidean quadratic pullbacks by an actual norm symmetry and then performs a complete analytic optimization on both sign sectors. Numerical values are checks only. Literature noncoverage statements are limited to inspected sources and recorded searches.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the real two-dimensional cubic Day--James ell_1-ell_3 plane. It does not assert a complete formula for ell_1-ell_p or general ell_p-ell_q Day--James spaces.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance of the cubic Day--James \(\ell_1-\ell_3\) plane
